# Test: grove list preserves newlines in worktree paths
# Windows filenames cannot contain newlines.
[windows] skip
setup_workspace

exec sh -c 'path=$(printf "%s\n%s" "$WORK/workspace/newline" worktree); git -C "$WORK/workspace/.bare" worktree add "$path" -b newline-worktree'
exec grove list --json
stdout '"path": ".*[/\\]newline\\nworktree"'
